# CROSSWORD: a new puzzle every time, in English or in Italian.
#
# The puzzle is built on the board from a list of words with their clues
# (the modules words_en and words_it): the first word goes across the middle
# of an 11 x 11 grid, then words that cross the ones already there are added,
# up to TARGET words, never touching side by side.
#
# Tap a square to choose it, tap it again to switch between Across and Down.
# Type with the keys at the bottom; Del clears. < and > go to the previous and
# the next word. Check marks the wrong letters in red, Reveal fills in the
# word you are on (in blue). The language is kept in cac_settings.json,
# section "crossword".
#
# Rules for the ESP32: the 121 squares and their letters are LVGL objects made
# once in setup(); a redraw changes only the squares whose look changed.
import time
import urandom as random
import cac_settings
import words_en
import words_it

N = 11                     # squares per side
CELL = 26                  # step between two squares
BOX = 24                   # side of one square
TARGET = 12                # words in a puzzle
MIN_WORDS = 8              # fewer than this: build it again
TRIES = 180                # words tried for one puzzle
LANGS = ("en", "it")
LISTS = {"en": words_en.WORDS, "it": words_it.WORDS}
TEXT = {
    "en": {"new": "New", "check": "Check", "reveal": "Reveal", "other": "Italiano",
           "dirs": ("Across", "Down"), "filled": "%d/%d words filled",
           "solved": "Solved!", "wrong": "%d wrong", "right": "No mistakes so far",
           "making": "Making a puzzle..."},
    "it": {"new": "Nuovo", "check": "Controlla", "reveal": "Rivela", "other": "English",
           "dirs": ("Orizzontale", "Verticale"), "filled": "%d/%d parole complete",
           "solved": "Risolto!", "wrong": "%d sbagliate", "right": "Finora nessun errore",
           "making": "Preparo lo schema..."},
}

# Looks of a square: background and letter colour.
BG_NONE, BG_PLAIN, BG_WORD, BG_CURSOR, BG_DONE = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
BG_COLORS = (0x2F2E36, 0xFFFFFF, 0xCFE2F3, 0xF6C945, 0xC4E5B5)
INK_PLAIN, INK_WRONG, INK_SHOWN = 0, 1, 2
INK_COLORS = (0x1E1E24, 0xD03030, 0x2E6FD8)

sol = bytearray(N * N)     # letter of the solution, 0 = no square
cur = bytearray(N * N)     # letter typed, 0 = empty
ink = bytearray(N * N)     # INK_*: wrong after Check, shown by Reveal
dirs = bytearray(N * N)    # bit 0: in a word across, bit 1: in a word down
word_at = ([-1] * (N * N), [-1] * (N * N))   # word index across / down of a square
words = []                 # (start square, direction, word, clue)
where = {}                 # letter code -> squares holding it, while building

boxes = []
letters = []
bg_colors = []
ink_colors = []
shown_bg = bytearray(N * N)
shown_ink = bytearray(N * N)
shown_ch = bytearray(N * N)
ready = False

lang = "en"
state = "making"           # "making", "play", "solved"
sel = 0                    # square of the cursor
way = 0                    # 0 across, 1 down
start_ms = 0
note = ""                  # message under the clue after Check
solved_in = ""             # time it took, frozen when solved
shown_status = None


def t(key):
    return TEXT[lang][key]


def setup():
    global ready, lang
    if not ready:
        for c in BG_COLORS:
            bg_colors.append(lv.color_hex(c))
        for c in INK_COLORS:
            ink_colors.append(lv.color_hex(c))
        for p in range(N * N):
            b = lv.obj(ui.grid)
            b.remove_style_all()
            b.set_size(BOX, BOX)
            b.set_pos(2 + (p % N) * CELL, 2 + (p // N) * CELL)
            b.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, lv.PART.MAIN)
            b.set_style_radius(2, lv.PART.MAIN)
            b.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.CLICKABLE)
            b.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
            label = lv.label(b)
            label.set_text("")
            label.set_style_text_font(lv.font_montserrat_16, lv.PART.MAIN)
            label.center()
            boxes.append(b)
            letters.append(label)
            shown_bg[p] = 255
            shown_ink[p] = 255
        ui.grid.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.SCROLLABLE)
        ui.clue.set_long_mode(lv.label.LONG_MODE.WRAP)
        ready = True
    lang = cac_settings.section("crossword").get("lang", "en")
    if lang not in LANGS:
        lang = "en"
    apply_language()
    begin()


def apply_language():
    ui.btn_new.get_child(0).set_text(t("new"))
    ui.btn_check.get_child(0).set_text(t("check"))
    ui.btn_reveal.get_child(0).set_text(t("reveal"))
    ui.btn_lang.get_child(0).set_text(t("other"))


def switch_language():
    global lang
    lang = LANGS[(LANGS.index(lang) + 1) % len(LANGS)]
    try:
        cac_settings.set_section("crossword", {"lang": lang})
    except Exception as e:
        print("crossword: language not saved:", repr(e))
    apply_language()
    begin()


def begin():
    """Show that a puzzle is coming: the next tick builds it, so the screen updates first."""
    global state
    state = "making"
    for p in range(N * N):
        sol[p] = 0
    redraw()
    ui.clue_head.set_text("")
    ui.clue.set_text(t("making"))
    ui.status.set_text("")


def beep(hz, ms):
    try:
        ui.buzzer.beep(hz, ms)
    except Exception:
        pass


# ---- building a puzzle ---------------------------------------------------

def _fits(w, r0, c0, d):
    """How many squares word w shares with the grid if it starts at (r0, c0), 0 if it cannot go there."""
    n = len(w)
    dr, dc = (0, 1) if d == 0 else (1, 0)
    r1 = r0 + dr * (n - 1)
    c1 = c0 + dc * (n - 1)
    if r0 < 0 or c0 < 0 or r1 >= N or c1 >= N:
        return 0
    r, c = r0 - dr, c0 - dc                       # the square before the word is empty
    if r >= 0 and c >= 0 and sol[r * N + c]:
        return 0
    r, c = r1 + dr, c1 + dc                       # and the one after it
    if r < N and c < N and sol[r * N + c]:
        return 0
    bit = 1 << d
    cross = 0
    for k in range(n):
        r = r0 + dr * k
        c = c0 + dc * k
        p = r * N + c
        v = sol[p]
        if v:
            if v != w[k] or dirs[p] & bit:
                return 0
            cross += 1
        elif d == 0:                                # no letter just above or below
            if (r > 0 and sol[p - N]) or (r < N - 1 and sol[p + N]):
                return 0
        else:                                       # no letter just left or right
            if (c > 0 and sol[p - 1]) or (c < N - 1 and sol[p + 1]):
                return 0
    if cross == n:
        return 0
    return cross


def _place(w, r0, c0, d, clue):
    dr, dc = (0, 1) if d == 0 else (1, 0)
    for k in range(len(w)):
        p = (r0 + dr * k) * N + c0 + dc * k
        if not sol[p]:
            sol[p] = w[k]
            where.setdefault(w[k], []).append(p)
        dirs[p] |= 1 << d
    words.append((r0 * N + c0, d, w, clue))


def _best_spot(w):
    best = None
    best_score = 0
    for i in range(len(w)):
        for p in where.get(w[i], ()):
            r, c = divmod(p, N)
            for d in (0, 1):
                if dirs[p] & (1 << d):
                    continue
                if d == 0:
                    s = _fits(w, r, c - i, 0)
                    spot = (r, c - i, 0)
                else:
                    s = _fits(w, r - i, c, 1)
                    spot = (r - i, c, 1)
                if s:
                    s = s * 16 + (random.getrandbits(4))   # more crossings first, then chance
                    if s > best_score:
                        best_score = s
                        best = spot
    return best


def _try_build(pool):
    for p in range(N * N):
        sol[p] = 0
        dirs[p] = 0
    words.clear()
    where.clear()
    order = list(range(len(pool)))
    for i in range(len(order) - 1, 0, -1):         # shuffle
        j = random.getrandbits(16) % (i + 1)
        order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
    first = None
    for i in order:
        if 6 <= len(pool[i][0]) <= 9:
            first = i
            break
    if first is None:
        first = order[0]
    w, clue = pool[first]
    d = random.getrandbits(1)
    if d == 0:
        _place(w, N // 2, (N - len(w)) // 2, 0, clue)
    else:
        _place(w, (N - len(w)) // 2, N // 2, 1, clue)
    used = {first}
    tries = 0
    for _ in range(2):                              # a second pass fills gaps left by the first
        for i in order:
            if len(words) >= TARGET or tries >= TRIES:
                return
            if i in used:
                continue
            tries += 1
            w, clue = pool[i]
            spot = _best_spot(w)
            if spot:
                _place(w, spot[0], spot[1], spot[2], clue)
                used.add(i)


def build():
    global state, sel, way, start_ms, note
    pool = [(e[:e.index("|")].encode(), e[e.index("|") + 1:]) for e in LISTS[lang]]
    pool = [e for e in pool if 3 <= len(e[0]) <= N]
    for _ in range(6):
        _try_build(pool)
        if len(words) >= MIN_WORDS:
            break
    words.sort(key=lambda w: (w[1], w[0]))         # across first, then down, top to bottom
    for m in word_at:
        for p in range(N * N):
            m[p] = -1
    for i, (s, d, w, clue) in enumerate(words):
        step = 1 if d == 0 else N
        for k in range(len(w)):
            word_at[d][s + k * step] = i
    for p in range(N * N):
        cur[p] = 0
        ink[p] = INK_PLAIN
    where.clear()
    state = "play"
    note = ""
    start_ms = time.ticks_ms()
    go_word(0)


# ---- playing ---------------------------------------------------------------

def word_cells(i):
    s, d, w, clue = words[i]
    step = 1 if d == 0 else N
    return [s + k * step for k in range(len(w))]


def current_word():
    return word_at[way][sel]


def go_word(i):
    global sel, way
    i %= len(words)
    s, d, w, clue = words[i]
    way = d
    cells = word_cells(i)
    sel = cells[0]
    for p in cells:
        if not cur[p]:
            sel = p
            break
    redraw()


def tap(x, y):
    global sel, way
    if state != "play":
        return
    a = lv.area_t()
    ui.grid.get_coords(a)
    c = (x - a.x1 - 2) // CELL
    r = (y - a.y1 - 2) // CELL
    if c < 0 or r < 0 or c >= N or r >= N:
        return
    p = r * N + c
    if not sol[p]:
        return
    if p == sel:
        if word_at[1 - way][p] >= 0:
            way = 1 - way
    else:
        sel = p
        if word_at[way][p] < 0:
            way = 1 - way
    beep(1200, 8)
    redraw()


def type_key(text):
    global sel, note
    if state != "play" or not text:
        return
    cells = word_cells(current_word())
    k = cells.index(sel)
    if text == "Del":
        if cur[sel] and ink[sel] != INK_SHOWN:
            cur[sel] = 0
            ink[sel] = INK_PLAIN
        elif k > 0:
            sel = cells[k - 1]
            if ink[sel] != INK_SHOWN:
                cur[sel] = 0
                ink[sel] = INK_PLAIN
    else:
        if ink[sel] != INK_SHOWN:
            cur[sel] = ord(text[0])
            ink[sel] = INK_PLAIN
        if k + 1 < len(cells):
            sel = cells[k + 1]
    note = ""
    beep(900, 6)
    after_change()


def check():
    global note
    if state != "play":
        return
    wrong = 0
    for p in range(N * N):
        if cur[p] and cur[p] != sol[p]:
            ink[p] = INK_WRONG
            wrong += 1
    note = t("wrong") % wrong if wrong else t("right")
    beep(330 if wrong else 784, 80)
    redraw()


def reveal():
    if state != "play":
        return
    for p in word_cells(current_word()):
        if cur[p] != sol[p]:
            cur[p] = sol[p]
            ink[p] = INK_SHOWN
    after_change()


def after_change():
    global state
    for p in range(N * N):
        if sol[p] and cur[p] != sol[p]:
            redraw()
            return
    global solved_in
    state = "solved"
    solved_in = clock_text()
    redraw()
    for hz in (523, 659, 784, 1047):
        beep(hz, 90)


def clock_text():
    s = time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), start_ms) // 1000
    return "%d:%02d" % (s // 60, s % 60)


def show_status():
    global shown_status
    if state == "play":
        filled = 0
        for i in range(len(words)):
            if all(cur[p] for p in word_cells(i)):
                filled += 1
        text = clock_text() + "   " + (t("filled") % (filled, len(words)))
        if note:
            text += "\n" + note
    elif state == "solved":
        text = t("solved") + "  " + solved_in
    else:
        text = ""
    if text != shown_status:
        shown_status = text
        ui.status.set_text(text)


def redraw():
    global start_ms
    word = set(word_cells(current_word())) if state == "play" else ()
    for p in range(N * N):
        if not sol[p]:
            bg = BG_NONE
        elif state == "solved":
            bg = BG_DONE
        elif p == sel:
            bg = BG_CURSOR
        elif p in word:
            bg = BG_WORD
        else:
            bg = BG_PLAIN
        b = boxes[p]
        if bg != shown_bg[p]:
            if bg == BG_NONE:
                b.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
            else:
                if shown_bg[p] in (BG_NONE, 255):
                    b.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
                b.set_style_bg_color(bg_colors[bg], lv.PART.MAIN)
            shown_bg[p] = bg
        ch = cur[p] if sol[p] else 0
        if ch != shown_ch[p]:
            letters[p].set_text(chr(ch) if ch else "")
            shown_ch[p] = ch
        if ink[p] != shown_ink[p]:
            letters[p].set_style_text_color(ink_colors[ink[p]], lv.PART.MAIN)
            shown_ink[p] = ink[p]
    if state == "play":
        i = current_word()
        s, d, w, clue = words[i]
        ui.clue_head.set_text("%s  %d/%d" % (t("dirs")[d], i + 1, len(words)))
        ui.clue.set_text("%s (%d)" % (clue, len(w)))
    elif state == "solved":
        ui.clue_head.set_text("")
        ui.clue.set_text("")
    show_status()


def key_pressed():
    m = ui.keys
    i = m.get_selected_button()
    if i is None or i < 0:
        return
    type_key(m.get_button_text(i))


def pick_square():
    p = lv.point_t()
    lv.indev_active().get_point(p)
    tap(p.x, p.y)


def on_tick():
    if state == "making":
        build()
    else:
        show_status()
